entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated a PDU session release procedure and is waiting for a response from the network.

entities.name: PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: Waiting for network response
entities.description: Condition where the UE is waiting for a response from the network after initiating PDU session release.

relations.description: The PDU session release procedure requires the UE to be in PDU SESSION INACTIVE PENDING state while waiting for network response.
The state is guarded by the condition of waiting for network response.
